model_annotation: Figure 15, titled "Distribution of Quantifiers and Operations in Categorical, Approximate Number Generation, Disjunctive Reasoning, and Conjunctive Reasoning," is a pie chart that visually represents the proportion of different types of quantifiers and operations across four distinct reasoning subfields. The chart is divided into four colored segments, each corresponding to one of the subfields listed in the title. The largest segment, colored light blue, represents Categorical reasoning and occupies approximately 40% of the chart. The second largest segment, colored light green, represents Approximate Number Generation and accounts for about 30%. The third segment, colored light purple, represents Disjunctive Reasoning and makes up roughly 20% of the distribution. The smallest segment, colored light orange, represents Conjunctive Reasoning and constitutes approximately 10%. The chart uses a simple color-coded scheme to differentiate the subfields, and the percentages are not explicitly labeled within the slices, but their relative sizes are clearly indicated.
